column1: # Web derivative build list for studiojoe.dev media.
# Columns: out_name <TAB> source_path <TAB> scale <TAB> crf <TAB> trim
#   scale  ffmpeg scale expr; use -2 for the free axis so dims stay even
#   crf    higher = smaller. 30 is the house default; drop to 26 for thin-line passes
#   trim   "-" for whole clip, or "START:DURATION" in seconds
# Sources live outside the repo on purpose. $MC = ~/Documents/Comfy (masters, JDrive),
# $SV = ./vfx (existing web cuts, used where no better master exists).
